Intro: Hello dear. Time is short, so I'm going to be honest with you; I have been testing you, to see whether you were someone I could trust.
Lovro Square has a secret. In the past, we were once docile to Svetka, never daring to rebel. But one day…
Dusan had done something unforgivable to one of my girls. This street decided enough was enough, and plotted a lie. One that he had spoiled.
We learned defiance that day. But, it seems Svetka has caught on. Repose is under watch, so I need you to hold onto this for me, Dear.
Success: Thank you…and I'm sorry. I don't mean this to sound threatening, but there are too many of us riding on this. I would do anything to protect my girls.
Fail: Thank you…and I'm sorry. I don't mean this to sound threatening, but there are too many of us riding on this. I would do anything to protect my girls.
Reject: No…you can't! If I'm gone, who will protect Repose!? I thought I could trust you!
